title: Add dataset members request v1
description: POST /api/v1/datasets/{datasetId}/clips body (staff only): up to 100 distinct clips whose LATEST review is approved and whose job is the recording's current accepted result. The batch is all-or-nothing. In a dataset shared with recipients every enabled recipient must also hold active operator-recorded clearance for each clip, otherwise the request fails with 403. Duplicate IDs are rejected by the service.
